Guidance & outlook: Dividend During the FY 2025-2026 your board of directors has recommended final dividend of INR 1.50 per share for the financial year ended 31st March 2026, subject to approval of shareholders.

Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) The Provisions of Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013 was applicable during the financial year 2025-2026 as the Company has crossed the threshold limit of INR 5 Crore for FY 2025.
As the required expenditure was below than INR 50 Lacs therefore Company was not required to constitute its CSR Committee during the FY 2025-2026.
Growth & demand: The Cargo business registered an impressive approximately 65% growth in cargo volumes, handling around 6,800 tonnes during the year as compared to approximately 4,100 tonnes in the previous financial year.
Similarly, shipment volumes increased by around 60%, with the Company successfully handling approximately 11,000 shipments against 6,700 shipments in the previous year.
Loan to related parties repayable on demand carry an interest rate of 10.00% p.a. c.
Margins & costs: The logistics industry operates in a competitive environment where margins can be affected by changes in freight rates, transportation costs, fuel prices, manpower costs and other operating expenses.
Cost Volatility Fluctuations in fuel prices, transportation costs, manpower costs and other operating expenses may affect margins.
The Company reported an EBITDA of INR 2,323.30 Lakhs, compared to INR 2,571.89 Lakhs in the previous year.
Capex & expansion: This strong operational momentum was complemented by an approximately 35% expansion in the Company's customer base, reflecting increasing customer confidence, improved service delivery, and the Company's growing market reach.
